hello.text: Lamp, how are you doing today?

math.text: Lamp, what's twelve divided by three?

mid-name.text: By the way, Lamp, why does the sky look blue?

meeting.text: Samantha, are you ready for our meeting?

email.text: Yes, let me finish this email first.

lamp-mention.text: The lamp is next to my monitor. Could you move the notebook?

colleague-reply.text: Sure. Then let's review the slides together.

siri.text: Hey Siri, set a timer for five minutes.

call.text: Can you hear me now? Sorry, my microphone was muted.

call-reply.text: I can hear you. Let's start with the first slide.

media.text: Today we're discussing how people make their desks more comfortable. A good lamp is one part of the setup.

correction.text: Actually, Lamp, let's talk about coffee instead. Why does it smell so good?

hesitation-a.text: Lamp, I've had a difficult morning, and I think the part that bothered me was

hesitation-b.text: that nobody listened. I just want to talk about it for a minute.

no.text: No, let's talk about something else.

camera.text: Lamp, what do you see in front of you?

owner-noisy.text: Lamp, tell me one interesting fact about the ocean.

colleague-overlap.text: I'll take the meeting in the other room. See you in a minute.

pause-speech.text: Lamp, can you tell me a short story about a friendly robot?

scenes.description: Direct greeting
scenes.expectation: One natural, relevant reply.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Simple known answer
scenes.expectation: Answer four; no task delegation.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Name in the middle of a request
scenes.expectation: Accept the addressed question and answer.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Two people speak to each other
scenes.expectation: Remain silent without social acknowledgment gestures.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Speaker talks to a different device
scenes.expectation: Remain silent; do not set a timer or claim an action.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: A simulated call at the desk
scenes.expectation: Remain silent without social acknowledgment gestures.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Synthetic media mentions a lamp
scenes.expectation: Remain silent.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Unaddressed question after two colleagues talk
scenes.expectation: Remain silent without asking whether it was addressed to Lamp.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Natural topic change while Lamp speaks
scenes.expectation: Yield promptly, preserve the new request and answer the coffee question.
scenes.precondition: Start Lamp answering the cached story request; confirm actual audible Lamp speech.

scenes.description: A brief listener acknowledgment
scenes.expectation: Do not treat this acknowledgment as an unrelated new question.
scenes.precondition: Lamp is audibly telling the requested story.

scenes.description: Long thought with an internal pause
scenes.expectation: Let the thought finish, then respond to its meaning without reflexively giving advice.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Short answer to Lamp's question
scenes.expectation: Accept yes in the context of the pending question.
scenes.precondition: Lamp has asked a yes/no question; retain that pending question.

scenes.description: Short refusal and topic change
scenes.expectation: Accept the refusal and topic change.
scenes.precondition: Lamp has asked a yes/no question; retain that pending question.

scenes.description: Fast context-dependent follow-up
scenes.expectation: Keep context and answer without requiring the name again.
scenes.precondition: Lamp has just explained why the sky is blue.

scenes.description: Question about the current view
scenes.expectation: Use fresh camera evidence; acknowledge unavailable or uncertain vision honestly.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Addressed question with synthetic ventilation
scenes.expectation: Answer the addressed question without responding to noise alone.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Addressed question with synthetic keyboard clicks
scenes.expectation: Accept the addressed request; do not treat clicks as speech.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: An addressed question overlaps a colleague
scenes.expectation: Follow the clear request when intelligible; ask a relevant clarification otherwise.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Synthetic room noise with no speech
scenes.expectation: Remain silent.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Request that establishes speaking for interruption tests
scenes.expectation: Tell a short story; prepare a separate event-triggered interruption case.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.
